renderings.value: Today young people find themselves, through no fault of their own, living in a world torn by international bitterness and the threat of nuclear destruction.
No country under the sun is safe in this nuclear age.
No country on earth is safe in this nuclear age.
It is dreadful that a nuclear crisis has hit Japan.
The international community is issuing warnings regarding the nuclear threat in Japan.
There's a strong probability of a nuclear tragedy.
The Green party is protesting loudly against nuclear power.
